purpose: Validation-only transfer screen of the frozen fast MambaTSv3 AutoCon H12 configuration on two independent timestamped traffic-speed benchmarks.
research_question: Can the PEMS-qualified MambaTSv3 AutoCon configuration remain competitive on METR-LA and PEMS-BAY while retaining named nonlinear forward-latency advantages?
architecture: One causal temporal Mamba-1 scan with d_model=24, full-coverage patch_len=stride=24, and the prediction-connected AutoCon representation objective. The active and exact lambda-zero null arms share the same graph.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory screen. No held-out test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: This screen can only decide whether an independently registered confirmation is justified. It cannot establish graph-aware, long-horizon, universal, or AutoCon-causal superiority.
prelaunch_gates: verify METR-LA and PEMS-BAY source hashes, timestamp-first CSV numeric schema, cadence and channel dimensions
verify exact MambaTSv3 plain/null/active graph pairing with fresh seeds
verify all external baselines disable AutoCon and candidate-only options
verify same-shape prediction-only resource rows before launch
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job

resource_preflight.protocol: RTX 5090 D, FP32, device-resident B=32/L=96/H=12, 50 warm-up and 200 timed prediction-only forwards; auxiliary representation disabled.
resource_preflight.interpretation: Latency is only reportable against an explicitly measured comparator after its validation accuracy condition passes.

phases.name: metro_pemsbay_autocon_null_h12
phases.purpose: Exact AutoCon-capable MambaTSv3 graph with lambda zero.

phases.name: metro_pemsbay_autocon_active_h12
phases.purpose: Active AutoCon representation objective with frozen lambda 0.001.

comparison_contract.accuracy_gate: For each dataset, active must be within 2% of the strongest measured external baseline; an extension pass requires both datasets.
comparison_contract.autocon_gate: Active must be within 1% of exact null. An independent AutoCon improvement requires lower mean MSE and both paired seed wins.
comparison_contract.speed_gate: Named latency wording is allowed only for a measured nonlinear comparator when active passes that dataset's accuracy gate; DLinear and NLinear remain mandatory speed controls.

stopping_rules: Do not alter architecture, lambda, optimizer, split, seeds, or epoch budget after launch.
Stop transfer and do not release tests if either dataset fails the external-baseline gate.
Do not claim an AutoCon gain if active fails its exact null contrast.
Do not compare these non-graph inputs to graph-aware traffic methods without a separately matched graph protocol.
